words.enDefinition: a card used for stock

examples.en: The storekeeper updates the stock card every time a batch leaves the warehouse.
examples.zh: 仓库管理员在每批货物出库时都会更新「存货卡」。

examples.en: When the auditor asked for the March figures, Manager Chen pulled out the stock card for that item.
examples.zh: 审计师询问三月的数据时，陈经理翻出了该物料的「存货卡」。

words.enDefinition: a book recording stock

examples.en: Every delivery is entered in the stock book before it goes onto the shelves.
examples.zh: 每批到货都要先登记进「存货簿」，然后才能上架。

examples.en: Our new clerk lost the stock book, so we spent Friday reconstructing the last month of entries.
examples.zh: 新来的文书把「存货簿」弄丢了，我们花了整个周五补录上个月的记录。

words.enDefinition: goods held for sale or use in stock

examples.en: The year-end count showed the stock inventory was worth less than the books claimed.
examples.zh: 年终盘点显示「存货」价值低于账面数。

examples.en: Slow-moving lines are piling up, so we will cut the stock inventory before the season changes.
examples.zh: 滞销品越积越多，换季前我们要压一压「存货」。

words.enDefinition: goods and materials a trader keeps for sale in the normal course of business

examples.en: A tailor's cloth and thread are his stock in trade.
examples.zh: 对裁缝来说，布料和线就是他的「存货」。

examples.en: The fire destroyed most of the shop's stock in trade a week before Christmas.
examples.zh: 火灾在圣诞前一周烧毁了店铺的大部分「存货」。

words.enDefinition: a process or check used to manage stock

examples.en: Good stock control means you never promise a customer goods you cannot ship.
examples.zh: 「存货控制」做得好，就绝不会向客户承诺发不出的货。

examples.en: Since the barcode system came in, our stock control has stopped relying on guesswork.
examples.zh: 上了条码系统后，我们的「存货控制」不再靠拍脑袋了。

words.enDefinition: stock currently held on hand

examples.en: Let me check the stock in hand before I confirm your order of forty cases.
examples.zh: 确认你四十箱的订单之前，我先查一下「现有存货」。

examples.en: The stock in hand will cover December, but January needs a fresh purchase order.
examples.zh: 「现有存货」够撑到十二月底，一月份还得再下采购单。

words.enDefinition: a card used for stock control

examples.en: Each shelf in the store room carries a stock control card showing what came in and went out.
examples.zh: 库房里每个货架都挂着一张「存货控制卡」，记录物料进出情况。

examples.en: Write the date and quantity on the stock control card the moment you take a box.
examples.zh: 一取箱就要在「存货控制卡」上写明日期和数量。

words.enDefinition: subject to being assessed for tax

examples.en: Dividends from that subsidiary are assessable to tax in both countries, so plan the withholding early.
examples.zh: 那家子公司的股息在两国都属于「应纳税」所得，所以要提前安排预提税。

examples.en: The inspector ruled that the bonus was assessable to tax even though it was paid in kind.
examples.zh: 税务检查员认定这笔奖金虽以实物发放，仍属「应纳税」所得。

words.enDefinition: a schedule or sheet presenting stock

examples.en: Hand me the stock sheet and I will match it against the warehouse count.
examples.zh: 把「存货表」给我，我来和仓库盘点数核对。

examples.en: The stock sheet lists each item twice, which is why the totals came out wrong.
examples.zh: 「存货表」把每种物料都列了两遍，所以合计数对不上。

words.enDefinition: stock currently on hand

examples.en: We can ship today because there is stock on hand for the blue model.
examples.zh: 蓝色款有「现货」，今天就能发货。

examples.en: The quote is valid only while stock on hand lasts, after which new lead times apply.
examples.zh: 本报价仅在「现货」售完前有效，之后按新交期计算。

words.enDefinition: a system for stock-control

examples.en: The new stock-control system flags any item that falls below its two-week level automatically.
examples.zh: 新的「存货控制系统」会自动标记低于两周用量的物料。

examples.en: Staff needed three weeks of training before the stock-control system stopped alarming them with false counts.
examples.zh: 员工培训了三周，「存货控制系统」才不再频繁误报盘点差异。

words.enDefinition: an amount due from others in respect of stock subscriptions

examples.en: Investors paid half on signing, so the rest sits in stock subscriptions receivable until the second call.
examples.zh: 投资者签约时缴了一半，余款在第二次催缴前挂在「应收认购股款」里。

examples.en: Two shareholders still owe money, so stock subscriptions receivable stays on the balance sheet at year end.
examples.zh: 两名股东仍未缴清股款，所以「应收认购股款」在年末仍列在资产负债表上。

collocations: tie out the stock subscriptions receivable

words.enDefinition: the process of estimating the worth of stock

examples.en: Under FIFO, the stock valuation rises every time raw material prices climb.
examples.zh: 采用先进先出法时，原材料一涨价，「存货估价」就跟着上升。

examples.en: Auditors challenged our stock valuation of the damaged goods, which we had carried at full cost.
examples.zh: 审计师对我们按全额成本计列的受损货物「存货估价」提出了异议。

words.enDefinition: taking of stock

examples.en: The warehouse closes early on Friday for the monthly stock taking.
examples.zh: 周五仓库提前关门，进行每月的「存货盘点」。

examples.en: During stock taking, nothing moves in or out of the store room, not even a roll of tape.
examples.zh: 「存货盘点」期间库房物料一律不得进出，连一卷胶带都不例外。

words.enDefinition: an audit required by law or regulation

examples.en: As a listed company, we cannot escape the statutory audit no matter how busy the year has been.
examples.zh: 作为上市公司，无论这一年多忙，「法定审计」都躲不掉。

examples.en: Small companies below the turnover threshold are now exempt from the statutory audit.
examples.zh: 营业额低于门槛的小公司现在可以豁免「法定审计」。

words.enDefinition: a record or balance used to track asset reduction

examples.en: Accumulated depreciation sits in an asset reduction account rather than reducing the machinery line directly.
examples.zh: 累计折旧记入「资产减项帐户」，而不是直接冲减机器设备科目。

examples.en: When we scrapped the old press, the asset reduction account finally cleared to zero.
examples.zh: 废旧压机后，「资产减项帐户」终于清零。

collocations: tie out the asset reduction account

words.enDefinition: a senior auditor who deputises for the chief auditor

examples.en: The assistant chief auditor signed off the working papers while the chief was at the client's site.
examples.zh: 主任审计师在客户现场期间，「助理主任审计师」复核签认了工作底稿。

examples.en: After five years on the engagement, she was promoted from senior to assistant chief auditor.
examples.zh: 在这个项目做了五年后，她从高级审计师升任「助理主任审计师」。

collocations: rely on the assistant chief auditor

words.enDefinition: a deputy to the auditor-general

examples.en: The assistant auditor-general will open tomorrow's briefing on the new performance-audit guidelines.
examples.zh: 「总审计长助理」将主持明天关于新绩效审计准则的吹风会。

examples.en: Questions about the regional offices go to the assistant auditor-general, not to the press office.
examples.zh: 有关各地审计特派办的问题要找「总审计长助理」，不要找新闻办。

words.enDefinition: a junior accountant who assists the chief accountant

examples.en: The assistant accountant matched every supplier invoice to its purchase order before month end.
examples.zh: 「助理会计员」在月底前把每张供应商发票都和采购订单核对上了。

examples.en: Our assistant accountant is studying for the CPA exam, so the chief accountant reviews her vouchers twice.
examples.zh: 我们的「助理会计员」正在备考注册会计师，所以总账会计会把她的凭证复核两遍。

words.enDefinition: professional standards governing how audits are carried out

examples.en: The working papers cite the statement on auditing standards that covers confirming receivables directly with customers.
examples.zh: 工作底稿引用了有关直接向客户函证应收款的「审计准则说明」。

examples.en: Every trainee reads the statement on auditing standards before touching a live engagement file.
examples.zh: 每名实习生都要先读「审计准则说明」，才能碰正式项目的档案。

collocations: sample the statement on auditing standards
vouch the statement on auditing standards
tie out the statement on auditing standards

words.enDefinition: a formal published statement about auditing

examples.en: The institute issued a statement on auditing to clarify how auditors should document management override.
examples.zh: 协会发布了一份「关于审计的说明」，明确审计师应如何记录管理层凌驾内控的情形。

examples.en: Her essay quotes the 1988 statement on auditing almost word for word.
examples.zh: 她的论文几乎逐字引用了1988年那份「关于审计的说明」。

collocations: roll forward the statement on auditing

words.enDefinition: the transfer of accounts receivable to a lender as security for a loan

examples.en: The bank approved the assignment of accounts receivable only after checking each customer's credit.
examples.zh: 银行逐一核查客户资信后，才批准这笔「应收帐款的转让」。

examples.en: Under the assignment of accounts receivable, collections still reach us but the lender holds the security interest.
examples.zh: 按这笔「应收帐款的转让」安排，回款仍先进我们账户，但贷款方持有担保权益。

collocations: accrue the assignment of accounts receivable
restate the assignment of accounts receivable
roll forward the assignment of accounts receivable

words.enDefinition: the use of statistical methods in collecting and analysing accounting data

examples.en: Statistical accounting helped the hospital compare bed-occupancy costs across its four campuses.
examples.zh: 「统计(性)会计」帮助这家医院比较了四个院区的床位占用成本。

examples.en: Instead of judging single transactions, statistical accounting looks at patterns across thousands of them.
examples.zh: 「统计(性)会计」不评判单笔业务，而是分析成千上万笔业务的整体规律。

words.enDefinition: accounts used to track asset

examples.en: Cash, inventory, and equipment all live in separate asset accounts on our chart.
examples.zh: 在我们的科目体系中，现金、存货和设备分别记在不同的「资产帐户」里。

examples.en: The trial balance refused to agree until we found a posting that hit two asset accounts at once.
examples.zh: 试算一直不平衡，直到我们发现有一笔分录同时记入了两个「资产帐户」。

words.enDefinition: a record or balance used to track assets

examples.en: Every vehicle we buy is opened in the assets account with its invoice number attached.
examples.zh: 每购入一辆车都会在「资产帐户」里立卡，并附上发票号。

examples.en: Deposits paid for machinery sit in the assets account until the equipment actually arrives.
examples.zh: 设备预付款在机器实际到货前一直挂在「资产帐户」里。

words.enDefinition: the conclusions and issues identified in an audit

examples.en: The findings of audit flagged thirty purchase orders that were approved after the goods arrived.
examples.zh: 「审计结果」点名了三十笔货物到货后才补审批的采购订单。

examples.en: Management must respond to the findings of audit in writing within thirty days.
examples.zh: 管理层须在三十天内书面回应「审计结果」。

words.enDefinition: a tax levied in respect of assets revaluation

examples.en: Revaluing the land upward triggered an assets revaluation tax bill for the subsidiary.
examples.zh: 土地重估增值让这家子公司收到一张「资产再估价税」税单。

examples.en: The finance director deferred the assets revaluation tax because the new rules allow payment over five years.
examples.zh: 财务总监递延了「资产再估价税」，因为新规允许分五年缴纳。

words.enDefinition: a tariff whose rate varies with market or cost conditions instead of staying fixed

examples.en: Under the flexible tariff, the duty falls automatically when world prices for the commodity rise.
examples.zh: 在「弹性(伸缩)关税」下，国际大宗商品价格上涨时关税会自动下调。

examples.en: Importers prefer the flexible tariff because it cushions them against wild swings in the exchange rate.
examples.zh: 进口商更喜欢「弹性(伸缩)关税」，因为它能缓冲汇率剧烈波动的影响。

words.enDefinition: a ledger recording credit sales and customer balances

examples.en: Before we approve credit for a new customer, I check their payment history in the sold ledger.
examples.zh: 给新客户赊销前，我会先在「销售分类帐」里查它的付款记录。

examples.en: The sold ledger still shows the March invoice as unpaid, but the bank statement says otherwise.
examples.zh: 「销售分类帐」里三月的发票还挂着未收，可银行流水却显示钱已到账。

words.enDefinition: capital available for a business’s day-to-day trading operations

examples.en: Late payments from two big clients squeezed our floating capital almost to nothing.
examples.zh: 两家大客户拖延付款，把我们的「流动资本」几乎抽干了。

examples.en: A supplier credit of sixty days lets the same floating capital fund twice the volume.
examples.zh: 供应商给60天账期，同样一笔「流动资本」就能撑起两倍的生意量。

words.zhGloss: 收取应收款项的自动化
words.enDefinition: the use of automated systems to collect amounts owed by customers
acceptedZhAnswers: 收取应收款项的自动化

examples.en: The automation of collecting receivables sends a polite reminder the day after an invoice falls due.
examples.zh: 「收取应收款项的自动化」会在发票到期次日自动发出礼貌提醒。

examples.en: Since the automation of collecting receivables went live, our average collection time dropped from fifty to thirty-one days.
examples.zh: 自从上了「收取应收款项的自动化」，平均回款时间从50天缩短到31天。

words.enDefinition: keeping separate accounts for each department of a business

examples.en: Departmental accounting lets us see that the bakery counter, not the deli, funds the rent.
examples.zh: 有了「部门会计」才看清，撑起房租的是面包档口而不是熟食档。

examples.en: Each branch used its own codes, so merging the departmental accounting took the whole summer.
examples.zh: 各分店科目编码各自为政，合并「部门会计」用掉了一整个夏天。

words.enDefinition: the Australian professional body for accountants that later became CPA Australia

examples.en: My supervisor qualified with the Australian Society of Accountants back when it was still independent.
examples.zh: 我的主管考的是「澳大利亚会计师协会」资格，那时它还是独立机构。

examples.en: The society's old journals show how the Australian Society of Accountants argued for standardized reporting in the 1970s.
examples.zh: 协会旧刊记录了上世纪七十年代「澳大利亚会计师协会」推动报表标准化的历程。

collocations: prioritise the australian society of accountants
standardise the australian society of accountants
monitor the australian society of accountants

words.enDefinition: the average number of days it takes to collect receivables

examples.en: Our average age of receivable jumped to fifty-two days after the biggest customer started paying late.
examples.zh: 最大客户开始拖延后，我们的「应收帐款平均帐龄」升到了52天。

examples.en: Keep the average age of receivable under forty days or the cash-flow forecast breaks.
examples.zh: 「应收帐款平均帐龄」要控制在40天以内，否则现金流预测就会失准。

collocations: sample the average age of receivable
vouch the average age of receivable
tie out the average age of receivable

words.enDefinition: accounting kept by an organisation’s supporting or auxiliary units

examples.en: The canteen and the staff clinic run on auxiliary unit accounting separate from the main ledgers.
examples.zh: 食堂和职工诊所单独采用「附属单位会计」，与总账分开。

examples.en: Auxiliary unit accounting answers to the finance department, though the units keep their own day books.
examples.zh: 附属单位虽有各自的日记账，但「附属单位会计」最终对财务部负责。

words.enDefinition: the level of average inventory

examples.en: Our average inventory level fell after we started ordering smaller batches twice a week.
examples.zh: 改成每周两次小批量进货后，我们的「平均存货水准」降了下来。

examples.en: A rising average inventory level with flat sales is usually a warning sign, not growth.
examples.zh: 销售平平而「平均存货水准」上升，通常是警讯而不是增长。

words.enDefinition: the mean value of inventory held over a period

examples.en: Divide cost of goods sold by average inventory and you get the turnover ratio.
examples.zh: 用销货成本除以「平均存货」，就得到周转率。

examples.en: We compare average inventory at the start and end of each season to spot overbuying.
examples.zh: 我们对比每季期初期末的「平均存货」，以便发现采购过量。

words.enDefinition: accounting for social performance

examples.en: The cooperative's annual report includes social performance accounting for its training and hiring programs.
examples.zh: 这家合作社的年报包含培训与用工项目的「社会业绩(成就)会计」。

examples.en: Critics argue that social performance accounting measures intentions more reliably than actual impact.
examples.zh: 批评者认为，「社会业绩(成就)会计」量得准意图，量不准实际影响。

words.enDefinition: an audit carried out at the branch or shop-floor level

examples.en: The floor audit turned up petty cash slips that nobody had signed for three months.
examples.zh: 这次「基层审计」查出三个月的零用现金单据无人签字。

examples.en: Branch managers dread the floor audit because it counts the till while staff are serving customers.
examples.zh: 分店经理最怕「基层审计」，因为它专挑员工接待顾客时盘收银机。

words.enDefinition: a tariff system a country sets independently rather than by treaty

examples.en: Because the two countries never signed a trade treaty, each runs its own autonomous tariff system.
examples.zh: 两国从未签署贸易条约，各自实行自己的「自主关税制度」。

examples.en: Parliament can raise duties overnight under the autonomous tariff system without consulting any partner.
examples.zh: 在「自主关税制度」下，议会无须与任何伙伴磋商就能一夜之间加税。

words.enDefinition: accounting that measures an organisation’s socio-economic effects

examples.en: Socio-economic accounting tries to put a number on the factory's effect on local employment and air quality.
examples.zh: 「社会经济会计」试图把工厂对当地就业和空气质量的影响量化成数字。

examples.en: The ministry piloted socio-economic accounting across state enterprises before publishing the framework.
examples.zh: 该部委在公布框架之前，先在国有企业中试点了「社会经济会计」。

words.enDefinition: an audit of an organisation’s social and ethical performance

examples.en: The garment factory passed its social audit, but the auditor noted overtime records missing for August.
examples.zh: 这家服装厂通过了「社会审计」，但审计师指出八月的加班记录缺失。

examples.en: Buyers now require a social audit before any new supplier can ship a single carton.
examples.zh: 现在采购方要求先通过「社会审计」，新供应商才能发出哪怕一箱货。

words.enDefinition: the reporting of an organisation’s social and environmental impact

examples.en: Through social accounting, the utility reports the villages it connected as seriously as its profits.
examples.zh: 通过「社会会计」，这家电力公司像报告利润一样郑重地报告它接通的村庄数。

examples.en: Social accounting grew out of the 1970s debate about what companies owe the public.
examples.zh: 「社会会计」源于上世纪七十年代关于企业对公众负有何种责任的争论。

words.enDefinition: a document used in audit

examples.en: Bring every audit document from last year; the successor auditor wants to see the confirmations.
examples.zh: 把去年的「审计文件」都带上，接任审计师要看函证回函。

examples.en: One missing audit document forced us to redo the entire payroll testing in November.
examples.zh: 因缺一份「审计文件」，我们十一月把工资测试整个重做了一遍。

words.enDefinition: the recurring sequence of steps in an audit, from planning to reporting

examples.en: Our audit cycle starts with planning in October and ends when the report is signed in April.
examples.zh: 我们的「审计循环」从十月的计划编制开始，到次年四月签署报告为止。

examples.en: Skipping interim work compresses the whole audit cycle into six frantic weeks at year end.
examples.zh: 省掉期中工作，整个「审计循环」就压缩成年底六个焦头烂额的星期。

words.enDefinition: a board committee overseeing financial reporting, internal control, and the external audit

examples.en: The audit committee questioned why the same supplier won every contract for three years running.
examples.zh: 「审计委员会」质询为何同一家供应商连续三年中标。

examples.en: Only the audit committee, not the CFO, decides which firm signs the external audit engagement letter.
examples.zh: 由「审计委员会」而非财务总监决定聘请哪家事务所签发外部审计业务约定书。

words.enDefinition: a government body responsible for public-sector auditing

examples.en: The audit administration published its yearly report on how the disaster relief funds were actually spent.
examples.zh: 「审计署」发布了关于救灾资金实际使用情况的年度报告。

examples.en: Every ministry must answer the audit administration's findings before the budget goes back to parliament.
examples.zh: 各部委须先回应「审计署」的审计发现，预算才能重新提交议会审议。

words.enDefinition: an audit that examines selected samples of transactions instead of every item

examples.en: An audit by test-checking examines every tenth invoice, so small errors can slip through.
examples.zh: 「抽查审计」每十张发票查一张，小差错可能漏网。

examples.en: The partner defended the audit by test-checking, noting that full verification would cost more than the fee.
examples.zh: 合伙人为「抽查审计」辩护说，全面核对的成本会超过审计收费。

words.enDefinition: a customs duty charged as a fixed amount per physical unit rather than as a percentage of value

examples.en: Coffee imports pay a specific tariff of twelve cents per kilogram, whatever the market price does.
examples.zh: 咖啡进口按每公斤12美分缴纳「从量税」，与市场价格无关。

examples.en: In a price slump a specific tariff quietly becomes heavier than an ad valorem duty.
examples.zh: 价格暴跌时，「从量税」的实际税负会悄悄超过从价税。

words.enDefinition: accounting for departments

examples.en: Under departments accounting, the kitchen and the gift shop report their results separately.
examples.zh: 在「部门会计」下，厨房和礼品店各自单独核算业绩。

examples.en: New hires spend their first week learning the departments accounting codes for every cost centre.
examples.zh: 新员工第一周要学的是各部门成本中心的「部门会计」编码。
